sentences.hanzi: 教师节以后，老师给全班同学写了一封感谢信。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié yǐhòu, lǎoshī gěi quánbān tóngxué xiě le yī fēng gǎnxiè xìn.
sentences.english: After Teacher's Day, the teacher wrote a thank-you letter to the whole class.

sentences.hanzi: 信里说：“你们送的礼物很好，但是对我最好的礼物，是看到你们努力学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn li shuō: "Nǐmen sòng de lǐwù hěn hǎo, dànshì duì wǒ zuì hǎo de lǐwù, shì kàndào nǐmen nǔlì xuéxí."
sentences.english: The letter said: "The gifts you gave are very nice, but the best gift for me is seeing you study hard."

sentences.hanzi: 小明看了信，心里很感动。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kàn le xìn, xīnli hěn gǎndòng.
sentences.english: When Xiaoming read the letter, he was deeply moved.

sentences.hanzi: 他对丽丽说：“老师这么爱我们，我们应该送给她一个真正的礼物。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Lìlì shuō: "Lǎoshī zhème ài wǒmen, wǒmen yīnggāi sòng gěi tā yī gè zhēnzhèng de lǐwù."
sentences.english: He said to Lili: "The teacher loves us so much; we should give her a real gift."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽想了想，说：“好！我们一起努力学习，用好的成绩送给她。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: "Hǎo! Wǒmen yīqǐ nǔlì xuéxí, yòng hǎo de chéngjì sòng gěi tā."
sentences.english: Lili thought for a moment and said: "Okay! Let's study hard together and give her good grades as a gift."

sentences.hanzi: 于是，两个人一起商量了一个学习计划。
sentences.pinyin: Yúshì, liǎng gè rén yīqǐ shāngliang le yī gè xuéxí jìhuà.
sentences.english: So the two of them worked out a study plan together.

sentences.hanzi: 他们决定每天放学以后，一起学习两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng měitiān fàngxué yǐhòu, yīqǐ xuéxí liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.english: They decided to study together for two hours every day after school.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，学习计划开始以后，小明遇到了一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, xuéxí jìhuà kāishǐ yǐhòu, Xiǎomíng yùdào le yī gè wèntí.
sentences.english: But after the study plan started, Xiaoming ran into a problem.

sentences.hanzi: 他的数学作业太难了，怎么想也想不明白。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shùxué zuòyè tài nán le, zěnme xiǎng yě xiǎng bu míngbai.
sentences.english: His math homework was too difficult; no matter how he thought about it, he just couldn't understand it.

sentences.hanzi: 他难过地对丽丽说：“数学太难了，我不想学了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā nánguò de duì Lìlì shuō: "Shùxué tài nán le, wǒ bù xiǎng xué le."
sentences.english: He said sadly to Lili: "Math is too hard; I don't want to study it anymore."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽笑着对他说：“别着急，我来帮助你。只要每天认真练习，你一定会进步。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe duì tā shuō: "Bié zháojí, wǒ lái bāngzhù nǐ. Zhǐyào měitiān rènzhēn liànxí, nǐ yīdìng huì jìnbù."
sentences.english: Lili said to him with a smile: "Don't worry, I'll help you. As long as you practice seriously every day, you will definitely improve."

sentences.hanzi: 从那天起，每天晚上，丽丽都耐心地教小明数学。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, měitiān wǎnshang, Lìlì dōu nàixīn de jiāo Xiǎomíng shùxué.
sentences.english: From that day on, every evening, Lili patiently taught Xiaoming math.

sentences.hanzi: 她一点儿也不觉得累，一道题一道题地给他讲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīdiǎnr yě bù juéde lèi, yī dào tí yī dào tí de gěi tā jiǎng.
sentences.english: She didn't feel tired at all, explaining the problems to him one by one.

sentences.hanzi: 慢慢地，小明都听懂了。
sentences.pinyin: Mànmàn de, Xiǎomíng dōu tīngdǒng le.
sentences.english: Slowly, Xiaoming came to understand it all.

sentences.hanzi: 一个星期以后，考试的时候，有一道很难的题。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xīngqī yǐhòu, kǎoshì de shíhou, yǒu yī dào hěn nán de tí.
sentences.english: A week later, during the exam, there was a very difficult problem.

sentences.hanzi: 小明想了很久，忽然明白了，他自己解决了这道难题！
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, hūrán míngbai le, tā zìjǐ jiějué le zhè dào nántí!
sentences.english: Xiaoming thought for a long time, then suddenly it clicked—he had solved the difficult problem all by himself!

sentences.hanzi: 他高兴地对丽丽说：“我自己做出来了！这是我第一次解决这么难的问题！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāoxìng de duì Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ zìjǐ zuò chūlai le! Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì jiějué zhème nán de wèntí!"
sentences.english: He happily said to Lili: "I figured it out by myself! This is the first time I've ever solved such a hard problem!"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽也为他高兴：“你看，你的努力有了进步。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě wèi tā gāoxìng: "Nǐ kàn, nǐ de nǔlì yǒu le jìnbù."
sentences.english: Lili was happy for him too: "You see, your hard work has paid off."

sentences.hanzi: 后来，小明的数学越来越好。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, Xiǎomíng de shùxué yuè lái yuè hǎo.
sentences.english: Later on, Xiaoming's math got better and better.

sentences.hanzi: 他们把这个好消息告诉了老师。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ zhège hǎo xiāoxi gàosu le lǎoshī.
sentences.english: They told the teacher the good news.

sentences.hanzi: 老师笑着说：“这才是送给我最好的礼物。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiàozhe shuō: "Zhè cái shì sòng gěi wǒ zuì hǎo de lǐwù."
sentences.english: The teacher said with a smile: "This is truly the best gift you could give me."
